cohort: 103 Japanese women who underwent cesarean section after oxytocin pretreatment
finding: Recovery time of 96 minutes or less and macrosomia were associated with increased risk of severe blood loss during cesarean section in women receiving oxytocin pretreatment.
mod_finding: In women who received oxytocin pretreatment, a recovery time of 96 minutes or less was associated with an increased risk of severe blood loss during cesarean section.
